龙国篇第二十三章神龙（二）
“给我，立刻回来！”
神龙的目光如炬，仅仅一瞥，便有一股难以言喻的神力汹涌而出，将正欲逃窜的诺克斯牢牢锁定在原地，动弹不得。
神龙轻轻晃动身躯，优雅而威严地飞至诺克斯面前，其声低沉而富有磁性：“我并非嗜杀之辈，杀戮于我，不过是迫不得已之举。
过往种种，你们那些小动作，我于九天之上，早已洞察秋毫，只是未曾点破，不愿徒增杀孽。
然而，时至今日，你们然忘本，不仅屠戮我族无数无辜性命，更胆敢亵渎龙帝雕像，推翻道古祭坛，此等恶行，叫我如何向龙帝交代？”
“如今我废你双翼，是谓警告，如有下次，灭你全族”
说完，神龙伸出前爪，猛的一爪，将魔龙王的双翼生生砍掉。
屏息之间，一场惊心动魄的对决骤然升级，神龙猛然间伸展出它那粗壮如峰、力量澎湃的前爪，快似疾电，直取向魔龙王而去！
“咔嚓”
一声清脆而震撼的裂响划破空气，神龙这一击威猛无匹，竟硬生生地将魔龙王那坚不可摧的左翼撕扯而下！
霎时间，血雨纷飞，魔龙王发出凄厉的哀嚎，其声穿云裂石，回荡在整个苍穹之下，令人心悸。
神龙却未有丝毫迟疑，趁势而上，锐利的前爪再次闪耀寒光，无情地挥向魔龙王的右翼。
这一连串的动作流畅而决绝，仿佛早已注定，不容任何阻挡。
正当神龙疾速逼近魔龙王之际，一股汹涌澎湃的黑红能量猛然自魔龙王躯壳内迸裂，犹如暗夜狂风，将神龙猛然掀飞数丈之遥。
这股力量不仅势不可挡，更在神龙的左爪上烙印下一道无法抹去的焦痕，仿佛是被深渊之火亲吻过的痕迹。
神龙低头凝视着那受伤的前肢，眼中满是不可置信的震撼。
“这股浓郁至极的黑暗气息，我岂能不识？它们本应蜷缩于无尽深渊的幽暗角落，苟延残喘，怎敢擅自踏上神龙大陆的神圣土地？”
神龙心中惊涛骇浪，思绪纷飞。
“不，绝不能允许！

魔龙王必须陨落，若他真与那不可名状的诡异力量结成了同盟，那将是一场灾难性的浩劫，其后果之严重，绝非我等所能预料。”
神龙的话语中透露出不容置疑的决绝，它的目光再次锁定于远方那魔气缭绕的身影，准备迎接一场关乎大陆命运的决战。
言尽于此，神龙猛然扬起它那对威严的双爪，带着不可一世的力量，向魔龙王猛力挥击而去。
刹那间，两股惊世骇俗的能量在空中激烈交锋，爆发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣，尘土与能量余波交织，遮天蔽日。
然而，就在这震撼人心的一击之后，竟是神龙身形一晃，被那股反噬之力狠狠震退数米之遥，尘土落定，一切归于沉静，只留下空气中弥漫的淡淡硝烟，诉说着方才那场惊心动魄的对决。
“没错了，就是那股力量，刚开始时我还半信半疑，认为它只是练习某种邪功，却不成想他竟攀上了异能兽，倘若任由他如此下去，后果不堪设想，龙帝推给我等的吩咐，我必须完成”
突然，魔龙王开口了，他双眼通红，说出的语气也开始了截然不同：“我的老朋友，你还记得我吗？哈哈哈哈哈……”
“太寒山一别，我们可是有1千多年未见了，你还是那个你，可岁月的侵蚀也让你不再年轻，不像我，我与我王一样不在畏惧岁月，永生已是我族常态，哈哈哈哈……”
“永生？可笑，自然之中没有永生，有的也就只有我族无上龙帝，他是恒古纪元就依然存在的神祇，是三界九州之至尊，是人族之辉煌，是我等之天帝，他带领我等打遍三界封号成神，洞穿九州脚踏六大神王，他还一人独断诡异，坦若真比起永生他是第一人。”
魔龙王笑了笑：“龙帝的实力我们有目共睹，但真的论战力而言他一人对抗得了五大诡异？我主就是其中一位，哈哈哈哈哈……”
“当五大诡异集聚之时，纵你们三界天帝联合也束手无策”
“我的老朋友啊，你还没发现你们的龙帝已有1万多年未回凌霄神殿了吗？这还不明白吗？”
只见神龙瞪大铜铃般的双眼，浑身鳞片根根竖立，口中喷出熊熊烈焰，愤怒地吼道：“大胆狂徒！

Dragon Kingdom Chapter 23: Divine Dragon (2)
"Give it to me and come back immediately!"
Shenlong's gaze was like a torch, and with just one glance, an indescribable divine power surged out, locking Knox in place, unable to move, as he was about to flee.
The dragon swayed slightly and flew in front of Knox gracefully and majestically. His voice was low and magnetic: "I am not a murderous person. Killing for me is just a last resort.
From the nine heavens above, I have already seen all the details of your little actions in the past, but I have not pointed them out because I do not want to increase the number of evils.
However, today, you have forgotten your roots and not only slaughtered countless innocent lives of our people, but also dared to desecrate the Dragon Emperor's statue and overthrow the Taoist altar. How can I explain to the Dragon Emperor these evil deeds? "
"Now I cripple your wings as a warning. If there is another time, I will destroy your entire clan."
After saying that, Shenlong stretched out his front paws and chopped off both wings of the Demon Dragon King with a sharp claw.
While holding his breath, a thrilling duel suddenly escalated. The dragon suddenly stretched out its front paws as thick as peaks and powerful, and headed straight for the Demon Dragon King as fast as lightning!
"Click"
A crisp and shocking crack cut through the air. The Shenlong's blow was so powerful that it tore off the Demon Dragon King's indestructible left wing!
In an instant, rain of blood flew, and the Demon Dragon King let out a shrill wail. The sound penetrated the clouds and cracked the rocks, echoing under the entire sky, making people feel heart-stopping.
The Shenlong didn't hesitate at all, taking advantage of the situation, its sharp front claws shone with cold light again, and swung mercilessly towards the Demon Dragon King's right wing.
This series of movements was smooth and decisive, as if it had been determined long ago and could not be stopped by anything.
Just as the divine dragon was rapidly approaching the Demon Dragon King, a surging black-red energy suddenly burst out of the Demon Dragon King's body, like a strong wind in the dark night, and suddenly lifted the divine dragon several feet away.
Not only was this force unstoppable, it also imprinted an indelible scorch mark on Shenlong's left claw, as if it had been kissed by the fire of the abyss.
Shenlong stared down at the injured forelimb, his eyes filled with unbelievable shock.
"How could I not recognize this extremely rich dark aura? They should be huddled in the dark corners of the endless abyss, lingering for breath. How could they dare to set foot on the sacred land of Shenlong Continent without authorization?"
Shenlong's heart was filled with turmoil and thoughts.
"No, it must not be allowed!
The Demon Dragon King must fall. If he really forms an alliance with that indescribable strange force, it will be a catastrophic catastrophe, and the consequences will be so serious that we cannot predict. "
Shenlong's words revealed unquestionable determination, and its eyes were once again locked on the figure shrouded in demonic energy in the distance, preparing for a decisive battle concerning the fate of the continent.
After saying this, the divine dragon suddenly raised its majestic claws and swiped at the Demon Dragon King with unparalleled power.
In an instant, two shocking energies clashed fiercely in the air, erupting into a deafening roar. The dust and energy aftermath intertwined, covering the sky and the sun.
However, just after this shocking blow, Shenlong swayed and was severely knocked back several meters away by the counterattack force. The dust settled and everything returned to silence, leaving only the faint smoke filling the air, telling the story of the thrilling duel just now.
"That's right, it's that power. I was dubious at the beginning, thinking it was just practicing some kind of evil skill, but unexpectedly it turned out to be a supernatural beast. If he is allowed to continue like this, the consequences will be disastrous. The Dragon Emperor gave us the order, and I must complete it."
Suddenly, the Demon Dragon King spoke, his eyes turned red, and his tone began to be completely different: "My old friend, do you still remember me? Hahahahaha..."
"Farewell to Taihan Mountain. We haven't seen each other for more than a thousand years. You are still the same you, but the erosion of time has made you no longer young. Unlike me, I am as different as my king.While we are afraid of time, eternal life has become the norm for our clan, hahahaha..."
"Eternal life? Ridiculous, there is no immortality in nature, and there is only the Supreme Dragon Emperor of our race. He is a god who has existed since the Eternal Era. He is the supreme of the three realms and nine states, the glory of the human race, and our heavenly emperor. He has led us through the three realms and become a god. He has penetrated the nine states and stepped on the six great god kings. He is also arbitrary and weird. Compared to being honest, he is the first person to live forever. "
The Demon Dragon King smiled: "We all have seen the strength of the Dragon Emperor, but in terms of combat power, can he fight against five weird things by himself? My Lord is one of them, hahahahaha..."
"When the five weird things gather together, even if you, the Heavenly Emperor of the Three Realms, unite, you will be unable to do anything."
"My old friend, haven't you noticed that your Dragon Emperor has not returned to Lingxiao Temple for more than 10,000 years? Don't you understand this? "
I saw Shenlong's eyes widening like copper bells, the scales on his body stood upright, and blazing flames came out of his mouth, and he roared angrily: "Bold maniac!
